name: tracksim
description: Deterministic sensor-fusion and multi-target tracking simulation sandbox with a real-time HUD

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @tracksim/hud
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sim/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hud/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
